title.narrative: Accelerating Actions to eliminate child labour practices along the agricultural value chains in Busoga sub-region.

description.narrative:
¿Accelerating Actions to eliminate child labour practices along the agricultural value chains in Busoga sub-region¿ aligns with the global objective of the EU Thematic Programme on Human Rights and Democracy promoting and protecting fundamental human rights freedoms, democracy, and the rule of law through reducing child labour in Uganda. It will focus on four outputs: 1) Vulnerable households, and families of child labour victims are supported to safeguard children and uphold their rights 2) The capacities of local government structures and stakeholders are enhanced to identify, refer and resolve child protection cases. 3) The community mechanisms to promote child protection and rights are strengthened and 4) Enhanced access to livelihood and employment opportunities that promote protective environment for children in Busoga region in the districts of Luuka, Iganga and Mayuge.

The action will contribute to promotion and protection of human rights and fundamental freedoms, democracy, and the rule of law through reduction of child labour in Uganda through strengthened civil society action, specifically through prevention and reduction of child labour in Uganda (Lot 2). The action begins with a comprehensive mapping of child labour in the intervention area. This will identify children and stakeholders involved in and affecting child labour and inform tailored response. The action works with stakeholders leveraging LWF and AWYAD¿s strong and extensive working relationships through proactive and responsive approaches. The action engages a range of duty bearers and rights holders, identified through the mapping, builds their capacities, develop alternative models of care and livelihoods to build resilience and well-being.
